programme.title: Switch
programme.desc: The life of a top star actor was turned upside down when he meets a taxi driver on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat the Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: The Way Home
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang-woo, a spoiled city boy, is sent to live with his mute grandmother in a remote rural village. Cut off from modern comforts, he slowly adapts as a quiet bond begins to form.

programme.title: The Hot-blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class
programme.desc: In the mid-1990s in South Korea, three female office co-workers who enroll in English classes in hopes to advance their careers, struggle to expose the corruption inside their company.

programme.title: Gate
programme.desc: A group of five conspired for one last heist, yet secrets inside the vault are large enough to overthrow the country.

programme.title: Tazza: the Hidden Card
programme.desc: Go-ni's nephew, Ham Dae-gil, enters the gambling underworld only to be used as a scapegoat in a deal gone wrong. Now he's planning his revenge by entering one big fatal game.

programme.title: Love My Scent
programme.desc: After wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger, Chang-Soo earns the ability to attract every woman in the world. Ara begins to sense the scent of Chang-Soo and falls in love with him.

programme.title: Return of the Mafia
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.title: Heartman: Rock and Love

programme.desc: Voice phishing victim infiltrates into the organisation's call center to recover the money, yet discovered another large scale scam ahead...

programme.title: Spiritwalker

programme.title: Amazon Bullseye

programme.title: New World
programme.desc: An undercover cop spends eight years to infiltrate South Korea's largest crime organization. When the head of the organization is killed, he becomes torn between his loyalties.

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: Picnic
programme.desc: Eun-sim is an elderly living alone in Seoul. She heads to her hometown after decades away. Her long-lost memories come to life one by one. This could be the start of one last picnic...

programme.title: Love Reset
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident...

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia memulakan kehidupan baru bersama Airel, namun perkahwinan mereka hambar kerana Airel masih teringatkan Sara. Sementara itu, Sara berusaha mendapatkan restu ayahnya untuk berkahwin dengan Irfan. Damia pula mengejar cita-cita sebagai model, manakala Airel semakin tertekan apabila mengetahui Sara sudah bertunang dengan Irfan.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya koma. Syarfan membesarkan Isabella sendirian. Hana telah ditangkap polis. Antasya mengalami amnesia dan Syarfan berjaya menyakinkan bahwa dia adalah suaminya. Hidup mereka damai dan gembira. Najwan meluahkan isi hatinya kepada Syafinaz dan diterima seikhlas hati. Alia turut menerima Nazrin yang bersungguh mengambil hatinya.

programme.title: 11 Cinta Sebelum Kamu
programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato' Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Cergas dan cekap Aisyah menyediakan segala keperluan buat diri Iskandar sementara menanti kepulangan Iskandar. Iskandar juga tidak sabar untuk pulang ke kondo itu bertemu dengan Aisyah. Iskandar terpaksa pulang lewat pada malam itu disebabkan mesyuarat penting TG Holdings. Aisyah menanti sehingga tertidur di ruang tamu. Aisyah menyangkakan Iskandar telah pulang, dia segera membuka pintu dan sangkaannya salah apabila Rey meloloskan diri masuk ke dalam kondo itu. Aisyah dan Rey bergelut, pistol dan pisau berada di tangan Rey. Aisyah cedera dan ketakutan. Dia berlari menyembunyikan diri di dalam bilik dan sempat menghubungi Iskandar. Iskandar meninggalkan mesyuarat itu, dia bergegas pulang ke kondo dan mendapati Rey ada di situ. Rey nekad mahu membunuh Aisyah dan mahu Iskandar rasa kehilangan nyawa orang yang dia sayang. Satu tembakan dilepaskan. Iskandar dan Aisyah membuat laporan polis. Mujur Inspektor Jefri sempat datang selepas dihubungi oleh Iskandar. Rey di masukkan ke dalam penjara. Iskandar berjanji akan menjaga Aisyah dengan sebaiknya, Iskandar bersyukur akan hadirnya seorang isteri yang memiliki keperibadian yang suci. Begitu juga dengan Aisyah, meskipun ingatannya belum pulih dia dapat merasakan kebahagiaan itu menjadi miliknya bersama Iskandar. Sangkar hati di buka, Aisyah bukan lagi seorang isteri yang menumpang kasih dalam hati seorang lelaki bernama Iskandar.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya

programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato' Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Cergas dan cekap Aisyah menyediakan segala keperluan buat diri Iskandar sementara menanti kepulangan Iskandar. Iskandar juga tidak sabar untuk pulang ke kondo itu bertemu dengan Aisyah. Iskandar terpaksa pulang lewat pada malam itu disebabkan mesyuarat penting TG Holdings. Aisyah menanti sehingga tertidur di ruang tamu. Aisyah menyangkakan Iskandar telah pulang, dia segera membuka pintu dan sangkaannya salah apabila Rey meloloskan diri masuk ke dalam kondo itu. Aisyah dan Rey bergelut, pistol dan pisau berada di tangan Rey. Aisyah cedera dan ketakutan. Dia berlari menyembunyikan diri di dalam bilik dan sempat menghubungi Iskandar. Iskandar meninggalkan mesyuarat itu, dia bergegas pulang ke kondo dan mendapati Rey ada di situ. Rey nekad mahu membunuh Aisyah dan mahu Iskandar rasa kehilangan nyawa orang yang dia sayang. Satu tembakan dilepaskan. Iskandar dan Aisyah membuat laporan polis. Mujur Inspektor Jefri sempat datang selepas dihubungi oleh Iskandar. Rey di masukkan ke dalam penjara. Iskandar berjanji akan menjaga Aisyah dengan sebaiknya, Iskandar bersyukur akan hadirnya seorang isteri yang memiliki keperibadian yang suci. Begitu juga dengan Aisyah, meskipun ingatannya belum pulih dia dapat merasakan kebahagiaan itu menjadi miliknya bersama Iskandar. Sangkar hati di buka, Aisyah bukan lagi seorang isteri yang menumpang kasih dalam hati seorang lelaki bernama Iskandar.

programme.desc: Airel dan Damia hidup seperti orang asing apabila Airel masih tidak dapat melupakan Sara. Airel semakin terdesak mahu mendapatkan semula Sara, manakala Dato Muiz menjemput Airel dan Damia makan malam bersama.

programme.title: Mariposa
programme.desc: Acha, pelajar baharu yang ceria dan penuh tekad, jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Iqbal, seorang pelajar pintar yang terkenal dengan sikapnya yang sangat dingin. Iqbal diibaratkan seperti seekor rama-rama Mariposa, setiap kali cuba didekati, dia pasti akan melarikan diri. Walaupun sering ditolak oleh Iqbal, Acha tetap enggan berputus asa, tanpa menyedari bahawa Iqbal sebenarnya sedang bergelut dengan tekanan berat daripada keluarganya.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Ariyana cuba memujuk Izz kembali, tetapi ditolak demi kebahagiaan Azz. Ryan pula mengancam mahu memusnahkan sesiapa sahaja yang mengahwini Dara, malah cuba merogol Manja sebelum dihalang Eunos. Sementara itu, Izz dan Dara bakal dikahwinkan tanpa sedar mereka sebenarnya merupakan rakan karib di media sosial.

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Kereta pancit Dara mempertemukan dirinya dan Izz di jalanan, mencetuskan pertengkaran. programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Ketika pulang dari berniaga sayuran, maimun dilanggar motor. Kecederaan kaki bertambah teruk. Doktor nasihatkan untuk memotong kaki supaya tidak merebak. Keesokkannya, usop datang menjenguk dan terkejut, maimun sudah di pondok usang mereka. Berbual melawak dan terbuka soal jodoh lagi untuk wok. Usop seloroh, dia boleh jagakan wok. Maimun pantas menolak. Usop senyum kelat.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla

programme.desc: Mikayla terpaksa membuat pilihan sukar antara mengejar kasih sayang ibunya atau menerima cinta yang hadir di hadapannya.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Dengan sokongan Idriz, Mikayla mula membina semula keyakinan diri dan mengejar impiannya dalam bidang solekan.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Datin Asmidar mula menunjukkan tanda-tanda penerimaan terhadap Mikayla, namun luka lama masih menghantui hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan 'The Kit Locker' dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya 'Qif' dan Bedah Kotak kasut Anaabu - Asymmetrical Blazer

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Alicia Amin, Immanuel Santosh, Eva Kamilia dan Pitahati.

programme.title: Milea Extended
programme.desc: Kisah cinta ikonik 90-an antara Dilan dan Milea kini diceritakan sepenuhnya daripada perspektif Dilan. Saksikan versi lanjutan yang membongkar babak terpadam penuh emosi, konflik dunia geng motor, serta kehadiran Ancika sebelum takdir mempertemukan semula Dilan dan Milea di majlis reuni sekolah.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Deris tidak diterima kehadirannya oleh masyarakat sekeliling. Banyak yang memandang serong dan melayani dia begitu teruk sekali. Sehinggakan dirinya dipukul dan dihalau. Pertemuan dengan si anak dara dua, penjual bunga di pasar iaitu jirannya sendiri suria menjadikan deris ada juga yang prihatin. Penemuan usop sekali lagi dengan deris telah mendatangkan idea untuk perkenalkan deris dengan wok.

programme.title: Rembulan Tenggelam Di Wajahmu
programme.desc: Ray, seorang pemilik konglomerat berusia 60 tahun yang kaya-raya tetapi kesepian, kini sakit tenat dan terlantar di hospital menanti ajal. Semasa berada di ambang maut, seorang lelaki misteri berwajah samar muncul lalu membawanya mengembara secara spiritual ke masa lampau. Sambil mengimbau kembali detik kejayaan serta kedukaan pada zaman mudanya, Ray cuba mencari jawapan kepada lima persoalan besar tentang kehidupan, takdir, dan keadilan yang selama ini sering dipersoalkannya kepada Tuhan.

programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke Sate 7 Pagi, Nasi Kukus Nasi Kerabu Cikgu Jani, Putu Bambu Raihana dan Delicious Shawarma.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Fendi kecewa dengan Arissa. Fendi menghantar gambar Shida dan Shariff bersama kepada Muhammad. Shahira dan TJ mula bertengkar dan TJ memutuskan pertunangan mereka. TJ pula ingin mengenali Arissa dengan lebih rapat. Fendi tahu akan keretakan hubungan Shahira dan TJ mula memujuk Shahira untuk bersama-sama menjatuhkan AR Holdings.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Mikayla dihadapkan dengan keputusan penting yang akan menentukan masa depannya bersama Idriz dan Asif.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Idriz akhirnya menyatakan perasaannya kepada Mikayla, namun reaksi Mikayla mengejutkan semua pihak.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Rahsia besar mengenai asal-usul Mikayla terbongkar, mengubah persepsi semua orang terhadapnya.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Mikayla berusaha memaafkan ibunya dan menerima masa lalu untuk melangkah ke hadapan.

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Mikayla akhirnya menemui kebahagiaan bersama Idriz, dan hubungan mereka direstui oleh semua pihak.

programme.title: Janji Arissa
programme.desc: Rancangan Fendi berjaya apabila Shahira turut berkomplot dengannya. Fendi memberikan Shahira beberapa bungkusan produk palsu AR dan akan diedarkan oleh Shahira. programme.desc: Izz dan Dara pengsan di pelamin selepas mengetahui identiti masing-masing. Mereka cuba menerima takdir dan tinggal berhampiran rumah Ryan. Dendam Ryan mencetuskan pakatan fitnah sehingga Dara ditangkap polis atas tuduhan pecah masuk. Sementara itu, Ariyana memulangkan cincin pertunangan kepada Azz, manakala Nita mendapati dirinya hamil anak Ryan.

programme.title: Satu, Dua…Dia?
programme.desc: Rayyan muncul dan mengacau kestabilan Mia-Isa, Jay turut merasa cemburu.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Maisarah tersinggung apabila menerima mesej daripada Aisyah yang masih mengejar Irfan. Namun, Irfan menegaskan dia sudah berumah tangga dan memilih Sara. Selepas berbulan madu, Irfan berpindah ke KL demi Sara serta membuka kafe Dapur Sara. Sementara itu, hubungan Airel dan Damia semakin renggang, manakala Damia mula rapat dengan Johan.

programme.title: Congkak
programme.desc: Kisahnya bermula apabila Kazman serta isterinya Sufiah mengambil keputusan bercuti bersama dua anaknya, Lisa dan Ely di sebuah banglo di tepi tasik. Kazman sudah berjanji dengan seorang kawannya untuk membeli banglo tersebut sebagai persinggahan semasa bercuti. Pelbagai peristiwa pelik berlaku sepanjang perjalan mereka termasuk kehilangan telefon bimbitnya. Setibanya mereka di banglo tersebut, peristiwa yang semakin pelik turut terjadi. Sufiah cuba meyakinkan Kazman untuk keluar dari rumah tersebut tetapi tidak diendahkan. Kazman tetap berkeras untuk membeli rumah tersebut kerana sudah berjanji dengan kawannya. Sufiah sentiasa merasakan ada makhluk sedang memerhatikannya. Salah seorang anak mereka, Lisa setiap malam akan turun ke sebuah bilik gelap untuk bermain congkak dengan seseorang yang hanya boleh dilihat olehnya seorang. Sufiah yang tidak boleh bersabar dengan perkara itu telah membuang congkak tersebut ke dalam tasik. Lisa juga sentiasa bermain di tepi belukar di belakang rumah kerana kawannya tinggal di situ sehingga Kazman perasan Lisa bermain menghadap kubur lama. Pada malam keesokannya, Sufiah dikejutkan lagi dengan bunyi congkak tersebut dari bilik yang sama. Apabila Sufiah pergi melihat, dilihatnya seorang tua sedang bemain congkak tersebut. Semakin lama peristiwa yang berlaku semakin pelik dan menyeramkan sehingga pada malam ketiga kedua-dua anaknya telah hilang dan Sufiah didapati tidur di siling bilik. Pak Tua, penduduk paling lama di kampung itu telah pergi ke rumah tersebut untuk menyelamatkan keluarga Kazman dan mencari Ely dan Lisa. Apakah sejarah sebenar banglo tersebut dan dapatkan Sufiah diselamatkan serta berjayakah Ely dan Lisa ditemui semula.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP18
programme.desc: Keazaman McCall untuk menangkap Mason Quinn, penjenayah yang bertanggungjawab atas kematian Bishop, membelok kepada obsesi berbahaya yang boleh menyebabkannya kehilangan segala-galanya.

programme.title: The Lift
programme.desc: Selepas sahabat baiknya hilang, seorang gadis kolej yang menghidap klaustrofobia mula menyiasat lif misteri tempat rakannya kali terakhir dilihat — lif yang mungkin merupakan pintu ke dunia gelap yang menakutkan.

programme.title: Gateway
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penjenayah terdesak mencari perlindungan di rumah yang kelihatan seperti rumah biasa - tetapi mendapati ia menempatkan sesuatu yang jauh lebih jahat, dan lebih dunia lain, daripada yang mereka sangkakan pada mulanya…

programme.title: Pontianak Harum Sundal Malam
programme.desc: Hantu perempuan resah mahu membalas dendam kematiannya.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai 'Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka' kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Don't Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Black S2 EP10
programme.desc: Black bertekad untuk menuntut keadilan ke atas nyawa yang hilang dan dihancurkan oleh penjenayah yang masih berleluasa.

programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: “Rajawali” mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

Zacky pula berhadapan dengan masalah diugut dan dibelasah kerana enggan menyertai satu kejohanan tinju. Dr Flora yang merawat Zacky sempat melihat sekeping gambar Zacky bersama Affiyah. Dr Flora terkejut dan memberitahu Zacky bahawa dia ada seorang kakitangan bernama Alia yang saling tak tumpah mirip Affiyah. Zacky lebih mementingkan diri untuk bertemu Alia sehingga sanggup mengenepikan urusan perniagaan keluarga. Sikapnya itu menimbulkan ketegangan ahli keluarga.Setelah membuat helah Zacky berjaya menemui Alia di klinik Dr Flora

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Berada di pejabat yang sama membuatkan Danny sering merasa cemburu melihat kemesraan Airra dan Aqil. Dalam masa yang sama Danny menjalinkan hubungan dengan Kisya. Kisya dapat mengagak Danny menaruh hati terhadap Airra tetapi Danny menafikannya.

programme.title: Ustazah Biker
programme.desc: Airra seakan tidak dapat menerima hakikat yang Aqil sudah pergi meninggalkannya. Keluarga Aqil menghadiahkan motorsikal Aqil sebagai tanda kenang-kenangan. Semasa hayatnya, Aqil memang gemar menunggang motorsikal berkuasa tinggi. Dia sangat sayangkan motorsikal itu malah Airra pernah terasa hati kerana Aqil seolah lebih menyayangi motor itu dari dirinya. Airra menerima hadiah itu dengan sedih. 5 tahun berlalu, Ziyad hidup bersendirian dan banyak menghabiskan masanya dengan berfoya-foya. Pesanan aruah isterinya agar dia memberikan pelajaran agama buat Firas menjadikan Ziyad sedikit tertekan.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Keriuhan suara orang kampung mencari Jamil dan Mastora membuatkan Jamil dan Mastora yang baru masuk semula ke zaman sebenar mereka terjaga. Mereka pandang sekeliling dan terpinga-pinga kerana tidak yakin apa yang mereka lalui tadi. Jamil tengok sekelilingnya hutan, dia tiba-tiba rasa gembira sebab dah kembali pada asal. Orang kampung menjumpai Jamil dan Mastora di hutan itu dan membawa mereka pulang. Malam itu di rumah Jamil, penduduk kampung datang ke rumah Jamil silih berganti. Mereka semua tercengang mendengar hebatnya berada di zaman moden dengan kecanggihan yang melampau seperti yang diceritakan oleh Jamil.

programme.title: Luka Tanpa Suara
programme.desc: Laila membesar tanpa kasih sayang keluarga dan dipaksa kahwin demi kepentingan mereka, lalu dia melarikan diri untuk mengejar pendidikan dan kehidupan sendiri. Bertahun kemudian, dia kembali apabila ibu bapanya uzur, namun dendam membuatkan dia sukar memaafkan—hingga kematian ayahnya meninggalkan penyesalan mendalam. Akhirnya, Laila memilih untuk melepaskan luka lama dan menerima ibunya, demi tidak terus hidup dalam penyesalan.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan

Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. programme.title: Lovely Runner
programme.desc: Right after Ryoo Seon-jae, a top star ends his life, Im Sol, his top fan somehow ends up at a time when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally meet.

programme.title: Bornean Stories
programme.desc: This collection of six captivating documentaries shines a light on the vibrant soul of Borneo, offering a glimpse into their living heritage, culture, and traditions.

programme.title: Fail Merah
programme.desc: Apabila sejarah memilih untuk diam dan media arus perdana sekadar menyentuh permukaan, kisah-kisah benar yang ganjil, tragik dan menyeramkan terus hidup dalam ingatan komuniti. Fail Merah mengangkat semula enam kes misteri dari seluruh Malaysia.

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: During the reign of the Ottoman Empire, four brothers from Lesvos face many dangers and become the conquerors of the seas

programme.title: Kubah Borneo
programme.desc: “Kubah Borneo” will bring viewers a closer look of mosques located at several districts in Borneo Island. The host will visit a mosque at a different location to learn and share the history of the mosque.

programme.title: Ready, Set, Go Kids!
programme.desc: Ready, Set, Go Kids! is a children's educational program where they travel to Kuching, complete challenges, and win prizes, while learning about the local culture.

programme.title: Khazanah Kenyalang
programme.desc: Dokumentari mengangkat 39 buah koleksi khazanah terbaik negeri Sarawak - yang tersimpan di Arkib Sarawak sebagai khazanah yang signifikan dan bertaraf dunia.

programme.title: My Journey With Nature
programme.desc: Pengembaraan seorang wanita ke kawasan pendalaman yang belum diterokai diceritakan dalam "My Journey with Nature", yang menampilkan tarikan pelancongan alam semula jadi.

programme.title: 3D Jobs
programme.desc: Aims to highlight and honor the unsung heroes of our communities who bravely perform challenging, hazardous, and dangerous jobs, showcasing their daily lives and their life stories beyond their work.

programme.title: Suara Alam Borneo
programme.desc: Suara Alam Borneo akan mengupasnya hutan hujan tropika berusia jutaan tahun secara terperinci dengan pelbagai spesis flora dan juga fauna menerusi informasi yang mudah difahami.

programme.title: Caves & Caverns
programme.desc: Our hostess explores Borneo's hidden gems, documenting her experiences, flora, fauna, paragliding, bird watching, and stunning sunsets, ensuring a captivating and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Marriage Of The Bidayuh

programme.title: Sarawak Women In History
programme.desc: Explore the lives of loud women who stood up for Sarawak, breaking barriers, social stigmas and creating history. This documentary, we celebrate and appreciate the reverberation of their voice to this day

programme.desc: This travelogue takes viewers on an adventure across Sarawak, uncovering underrated spots with unique food, heritage, and sights. Through POV shots and local guides, it offers a deeper look into the region's hidden gems.

programme.title: (L) Re Bao
programme.desc: Re Bao memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Mandarin

programme.title: Borneo From Above

programme.desc: Sebuah dokumentari kembara gastronomi yang merentas dari Perlis ke Sarawak, memperkenalkan keunikan juadah berbilang budaya yang memupuk perpaduan dalam kepelbagaian selera.

programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban

programme.title: (DL) Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Decimal Point
programme.desc: Weekly business show is set to become your trusted source for all things business, economics, and current affairs. Your gateway to making informed decisions in today's fast-paced business environment.

programme.title: Fail Merah
programme.desc: Apabila sejarah memilih untuk diam dan media arus perdana sekadar menyentuh permukaan, kisah-kisah benar yang ganjil, tragik dan menyeramkan terus hidup dalam ingatan komuniti. Fail Merah mengangkat semula enam kes misteri dari seluruh Malaysia.

programme.title: Travelawak Projek Bapak Bapak
programme.desc: Projek Bapak Bapak S3 returns with a new twist this time they are travelling to Dubai and Korea. Will they survive a double location adventure with jet lag, language barriers and crazier challenges?

programme.title: (L) TVS Nightline
programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English

programme.title: Mantan Tapi Menikah
programme.desc: Filem Mantan Tapi Menikah merupakan sebuah drama komedi percintaan bersiri yang mengandungi beberapa episod, yang mengisahkan dilema serta perjuangan hidup seorang gadis cekal yang memikul tanggungjawab besar untuk menyara dua orang adiknya, selepas kematian kedua-dua ibu bapa mereka.

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Beijing
programme.desc: Asma berkunjung ke Beijing selepas kecewa dalam percintaan dan bertemu Zhongwen, seorang lelaki yang membantunya mengenali erti cinta, kehidupan dan keikhlasan, sambil berdepan ujian penyakit yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Dania
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dania, seorang remaja penyendiri yang mula percaya kepada seniornya, Sarimah, dan dibantu oleh Cikgu Bahar untuk tuisyen percuma. Namun, Bahar mengambil kesempatan ke atas Dania hingga merogolnya, menyebabkan Dania trauma dan kemurungan. Abangnya, Luqman, menyedari keadaan sebenar Dania dan bersama-sama memperjuangkan kebenaran walaupun kes itu digugurkan.

programme.title: Kapan Pindah Rumah
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ariel dan Lydia yang memutuskan untuk berpindah rumah selepas berkahwin, namun proses mencari dan menyesuaikan diri dengan rumah baharu membawa pelbagai cabaran, konflik keluarga serta kisah lucu dalam kehidupan rumah tangga merek

programme.title: Pontianak 100kg
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Melati, seorang gadis yang suka makan dan meninggal dunia dalam keadaan lapar. Selepas berubah menjadi pontianak, dia menghantui penduduk kampung bukan untuk menghisap darah, tetapi mencari makanan sehingga berat badannya menjadi 100kg. Penduduk kampung cuba mencari cara untuk menghentikan gangguan tersebu

programme.title: #BerhentiDiKamu
programme.desc: Dr. Gia percaya Elsa ialah jodohnya selepas berdoa di Kaabah, namun selepas cintanya ditolak, dia bertemu Syafira yang juga sedang kecewa, lalu kedua-duanya menemui semula makna cinta, takdir dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Dunia Baru The Movie
programme.desc: Filem ini bermula apabila Opie menemui sepucuk surat daripada Anizah yang menyatakan bahawa dia ingin berkahwin dengan teman lelakinya, Fazley, dan telah menguburkan impiannya untuk menyambung pelajaran ke UK.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu
programme.desc: Kisah Putri yang cuba memenangi semula hati teman lelakinya dengan menyertai pertandingan futsal wanita bersama rakan-rakannya. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka belajar tentang persahabatan, keyakinan diri dan makna sebenar cinta.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu 2
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Gol & Gincu yang mengikuti kehidupan Putri dan rakan-rakannya selepas beberapa tahun. Mereka menghadapi cabaran baharu dalam kerjaya, cinta dan persahabatan, sambil cuba mengekalkan hubungan rapat yang telah lama terjalin.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Sejoli
programme.desc: Jo (Bront Palarae) dan Gina (Maya Karin) sedang menyembuhkan hati yang terluka di Phuket apabila takdir mempertemukan mereka. Pada mulanya mereka saling membenci, tetapi apabila mereka mendapat tahu bahawa bekas kekasih masing-masing, Hardy (Remy Ishak) dan Nita (Izara Aishah), akan berkahwin, mereka merancang untuk menggagalkan majlis perkahwinan tersebut.

programme.title: Lebuhraya Ke Neraka
programme.desc: Lebuhraya Ke Neraka mengisahkan sekumpulan penunggang motosikal yang kasar berhenti di tepi jalan, dan tidak lama kemudian, kesemua mereka—kecuali Bob—jatuh sakit secara misteri.

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna, usahawan berjaya yang ditipu tunangnya, Razi. Dia kecewa apabila perniagaan yang mereka usahakan rugi kerana Razi terbabit dengan skandal wang serta mempunyai perempuan simpanan. Sementara itu, Gie pula baru saja dibuang kerja. Walaupun masih mencari kerja, dia sangat tenang dan tetap ceria. Gie reda dengan situasi menimpanya.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Gila Gila Remaja 2
programme.desc: Filem ni adalah sekuel kepada Gila-Gila Remaja (1985). Ia bawa vibe remaja moden dengan konflik cinta, persahabatan, dan cabaran zaman baru. Kisahnya lebih fokus pada hidup remaja kolej & sekolah memandu, dengan isu sosial yang dekat dengan golongan muda — persaingan, cinta segitiga, serta impian masing-masing.

programme.title: Reaksiar

Menerusi persembahan yang semakin mencabar, setiap peserta perlu menyerlahkan bukan sahaja kehebatan vokal, malah bakat seni, kebolehan serba boleh, ketahanan mental dan daya tarikan pentas. Dengan persaingan sengit serta persembahan yang memukau, hanya bintang paling menyerlah akan mara ke puncak.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Teror Obsesi Mantan Pacar Suamiku
programme.desc: Kehidupan rumah tangga Adriana dan Vino mula terganggu apabila mereka menerima ancaman daripada individu misteri. Setiap malam, Adriana hidup dalam keresahan akibat gangguan yang berterusan, sehingga kebahagiaan rumah tangga mereka semakin terancam.

programme.title: D'Academy 8

programme.title: Big Boys Club

Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful "fun agents" for hints, but they'll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive "retraining" from the leader—what punishment awaits the guests?

programme.title: Only Fools Fall in Love
programme.desc: Zhao Fu (Lau Ching-wan) is the head of the Zhao family. Although wealthy, powerful, and exceptionally intelligent, his sharp-tongued and competitive nature prevents him from finding happiness. The second-in-command, Zhao Ji (Dayo Wong), has long harbored resentment towards Fu, compounded by his debts from gambling, drinking, and prostitution. He persuades Wang Di (Ng Sin-lin), a street performer, to enter into a sham marriage with Fu to swindle a dowry. Di and her father (Yuen Wah), wanting to settle down, agree. Before the wedding ceremony, Fu tries to steal fireworks, but Ji changes tactics, causing Fu to fall from a height in the chaos, leaving him mentally impaired. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Di and her father flee, changing their surnames and starting a new life. Ji considers killing Fu, but Fu escapes. Fate brings Fu and Di together again. At a market, Di sees Fu as a beggar, living a life of hardship, and driven by guilt and compassion, takes him in. As they spent more time together, feelings blossomed between them. The younger brother found it hard to believe he was moved by the sincerity of a simpleton, while Fu experienced unprecedented joy in love. On a beautiful, sunny day, Ji sent men to disrupt Fu and the younger brother's world, also affecting their neighbors. Fu and the younger brother decided they had to take advantage of their fair and impartial great-uncle's (Qiao Hong) birthday banquet to return to the Zhao family, expose Ji's evil deeds, and seek justice. Thus, a simpleton formally declared war on a cunning and treacherous man…

programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. " Cantopop At 50" invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: "News Perspective" is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Yan Oi Tong Charity Show 2026
programme.desc: This live fundraising gala by TVB and Yan Oi Tong raises funds for elderly care, medical support, youth education, and poverty alleviation in Hong Kong. Hosted by TVB presenters, the show features Cantopop performances, star duets, games, and short documentaries highlighting real-life beneficiaries to show how public donations help low-income families and vulnerable groups.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

Ah Jie has a wide circle of acquaintances, inviting guests from different fields, including Mak Ling Ling, Nancy Sit, Laurinda Ho, Philip Keung, Alex Fong, and Chin Ka-lok, to compete for the best performance and generous prizes!

programme.title: Just Love
programme.desc: Judge KO HEI MAN (HSUAN JESSICA HESTER) and KOT KWOK KWONG (CHAN KAM HUNG, SUNNY) have agreed that MAN will concentrate on her career while KWONG will be taking care of the housework after they get married. Everything is in harmony until KWONG's father discovers MAN and KWONG's pre-marriage written agreement. Their relationship complicates ever since. To make things worse, KWONG breaks the agreement and demands to have his own career. MAN does not pay much attention at first until she finds out that KWONG, who is free from family burden, is having an affair. MAN learns to become more affectionate in the hope of saving the marriage. Unfortunately, the whole situation deteriorates when KWONG decides that MAN is too close to her ex-boyfriend, TAI CHI HUNG (WANG CHIEH, DAVE), who is now MAN's colleague. Who has the right to decide who should be in charge of earning money instead of running the family?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals…

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."
